scenarioCoverage.expected: Repeated governance reads in one valid phase use the same repository, Runtime, Contract/config/policy, snapshot, and observed-fact identities without a hidden second observation.

scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run focused RepositoryExecutionContext and governance tests with call counters and assert one captured phase context and stable facts.

scenarioCoverage.expected: cockpit/profile/policy declaration identity changes invalidate the phase context instead of being silently mixed with the original snapshot.

scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Bind two isolated repositories and tamper the attached identity input; assert snapshot-root or repository-identity mismatch.
